answer.reason: The verses tell of his killing Pekah and of his imprisonment by the king of Assyria, both beyond what the summary states.

clauses.english: conspired against Pekah, killed him and reigned in his place
clauses.quote: made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him

clauses.english: was shut up and bound in prison by the king of Assyria for sending to So king of Egypt
clauses.quote: the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison

doubts: HOS 10:15 speaks of an unnamed king of Israel, so it was left out.
The fall of Samaria in his ninth year (2KI 17:6, 18:10) was left out as an event of the nation rather than a deed of Hoshea.
